worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.summary: Stick an arc on the target, then ride the current to blink to a new spot; the relay style also leaves a charged patch of ground behind, the plain style swaps to a waiting reserve. Repositioning instead of retreating, and the only ranged special of the three folds.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.use.0: Poke from range, then blink to a new position
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.use.1: Discharge and leave before being broken
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.use.2: Leave a charged patch to cut off movement
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.description: The arc strikes a non-allied living target for about %1$s special damage.
Range %1$s blocks, the arc flies at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block hit radius.
Blinks %1$s blocks and offsets %2$s blocks to the side; with a partner within %3$s blocks it lands behind them.

With the relay style, a charged patch of radius %1$s blocks is left behind for %2$s, hitting every non-ally inside with a %3$s-power Electric strike every 20 ticks (type matchup applies; Ground is immune).
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.relay.on: Relay style: leaves a zapping charged patch and stays on the field; arc power ×0.85, cooldown +6 ticks, blink ×0.85.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.relay.off: Plain style: arc power ×1.2, blink ×1.2, nothing left behind; with a reserve, swaps straight to it.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.growth.0: From level %1$s the arc rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.growth.1: From level %1$s the arc rises to %2$s.
On: after discharging, leave a zapping charged patch (area pressure, cuts off movement) and stay on the field, but arc power ×0.85, cooldown +6 ticks, blink ×0.85. Off (plain): arc power ×1.2, blink ×1.2 further, nothing is left behind, and with a reserve it swaps straight to it.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; a ranged move, so raising it blinks from further out and lowering it pokes only up close.
Below this health ratio, volt switch is ranked first to discharge away; raise it to leave earlier, lower it to keep it for emergencies.
When on, the user blinks away even under a hold order; off keeps it only when convenient in place.
worldcombat.skill.voltswitch.description: The blink happens whether or not the arc hits, including firing at open ground, and only once per cast; the landing is checked for safe space first, and with no ally to relay to the user blinks away from the aim with a sideways offset, pushed along that way when no free spot is found.
